propositions: Replace hand-rolled CLI argument parsing loops in claim.py and transition.py with Python stdlib argparse, preserving exact behavioral semantics including None-vs-empty-string sentinels, option-specific token-consumption rules, and error exit codes.

Implement WriteArgParser shared base with add_help=False (dispatcher serves byte-exact help unchanged), allow_abbrev=False (no prefix abbreviation), and custom error() override remapping argparse exit-2 to exit-1 CommandError with existing error messages.

Retain transition._parse_flags as argparse-backed shim returning identical 5-tuple to preserve three external direct callers (test_transition_force_flag_24f7.py, test_close_ref_target_80af.py, test_dependency_audit.py) and their None-vs-'' sentinel expectations.

Preserve command-specific --force semantics: claim bare --force consumes following non-option token (else '(no reason given)'), transition bare --force sets force_reason='' without consuming following token (None only when absent), both yielding identical observable '(no reason given)' after _force_note mapping.
Maintain --assignee None-vs-'' distinction (absent → default_assignee fallback, explicit '' → cleared) and reject value-less --assignee with exit-1 error message, not argparse default exit-2.

Reject retired --force-close with exit-1 custom message before argparse processing, use parse_known_args() to silently skip unknown tokens, and keep exit code 10 on ConcurrencyError; drain stale _parse_flags entry from complexity-baseline.json once below threshold.
